management_features.name: Product definition and outcomes
management_features.use_case: Define who a product serves, the problem, measurable outcome hypotheses and scope before classifying engineering work.
management_features.shall: Product specifications SHALL preserve a stable identity, purpose, stakeholder/source, outcome hypothesis, metric definition, scope and explicit unknowns.
management_features.negative: Reject a product with missing purpose or fabricated measured outcome.
management_features.implementation: Product specification metadata plus existing typed catalogs; outcomes remain unmeasured.
management_features.gap: Business outcome and customer-feedback lifecycle is not fully represented by the engineering catalogs.

management_features.name: Feature hierarchy and ownership
management_features.use_case: Navigate product, family, capability, contract, scenario, trace and receipt without losing the denominator.
management_features.shall: Every required feature SHALL have one containment parent and stable semantic identity; cross-relations SHALL NOT create extra parents or cycles.
management_features.negative: Reject duplicate IDs, missing parents, skipped required levels and empty completion trees.
management_features.implementation: Adapt the current Hermes fractal catalog and SQLite foreign-key graph.
management_features.gap: The inspected external product hierarchy tables are empty; candidate-bound graph completion needs a collector.

management_features.name: Typed feature definition and use cases
management_features.use_case: Inspect each capability's behavior, use case, UI controls and scenario references.
management_features.shall: A feature SHALL preserve ID, category, behavior, use case, control references, scenario references, declared state and observed evidence separately.
management_features.negative: Reject implementation claims backed only by a label or empty evidence list.
management_features.implementation: Use the existing InfraNodus typed registry shape and versioned product rows.
management_features.gap: InfraNodus metadata tests do not execute every referenced scenario.

management_features.name: Requirements and contract ownership
management_features.use_case: Trace each requested behavior to a falsifiable law and responsible component.
management_features.shall: Each requirement SHALL have a stable ID, shall statement, owner, contract/formal method, runtime acceptance and source reference.
management_features.negative: Reject a verified requirement with missing or stale contract/runtime receipt.
management_features.implementation: Existing Hermes contracts, Gospel methods and the new requirements projection.
management_features.gap: Formal ownership/registration must be distinguished from checked proof.

management_features.name: Specification and model projections
management_features.use_case: Produce consistent SysML, ontology and product views from one versioned specification.
management_features.shall: All derived model surfaces SHALL retain the same IDs, requirements and dependency edges and identify their source version.
management_features.negative: Detect a missing feature or changed dependency in a generated model; preserve toolchain validation as UNRUN.
management_features.implementation: Reuse Feature_model projections; new catalog exposes canonical source records.
management_features.gap: Projection generation alone does not validate an official SysML/OML toolchain.

management_features.name: Traceability across engineering artifacts
management_features.use_case: Find the code, test, document, UI and design behind a requirement.
management_features.shall: Typed artifact links SHALL preserve role, origin, digest and revision and resolve to an artifact version.
management_features.negative: Reject dangling artifact links and mismatched digest or semantic owner.
management_features.implementation: Hermes artifact/node/knowledge-link concepts with additive SQLite artifact links.
management_features.gap: Graph completeness and semantic validity require more than foreign keys.

management_features.name: Sa-plan execution linkage
management_features.use_case: Execute product work with durable task dependencies and recoverable ownership.
management_features.shall: Plans, tasks, jobs and workflows SHALL remain in canonical Sa-plan; catalog rows SHALL carry references only.
management_features.negative: Reject expired worker/attempt and never execute from an advisory product priority.
management_features.implementation: Existing Sa-plan CLI and preflight; catalog verifies current task ownership.
management_features.gap: Two-database observation is not atomic effect-time fencing.

management_features.name: Truthful feature state
management_features.use_case: Compare declaration, available source, observed runtime and admitted behavior.
management_features.shall: Declared, mapped, implemented, tested, verified and admitted observations SHALL remain distinguishable; missing evidence SHALL NOT imply completion.
management_features.negative: A declaration of Built without executed matching evidence must not increase strict coverage.
management_features.implementation: Reuse stale-declaration diagnostics; preserve a separate conservative catalog status.
management_features.gap: Legacy register can return Built when no probe exists.

management_features.name: Versioned change history
management_features.use_case: Review changes without destroying prior evidence.
management_features.shall: An identical object/version replay SHALL be idempotent and a changed payload at that identity SHALL be rejected; new versions retain prior history.
management_features.negative: Change a stored requirement under the same version and confirm rejection and unchanged history.
management_features.implementation: Existing immutable-key pattern adapted into product import records and SQL protection triggers.
management_features.gap: Administrative replacement of a SQLite file remains outside ordinary API protection.

management_features.name: SQLite artifact body storage
management_features.use_case: Recover the original architecture and authored reviews without depending on a filesystem copy.
management_features.shall: Generated/user artifact bodies SHALL be stored with media kind, SHA-256, source locator and immutable revision; source-code oracles remain reference-only.
management_features.negative: Tamper with an artifact body or supply a mismatched hash and reject import; byte-identical readback succeeds.
management_features.implementation: New native OCaml product_catalog import/artifact commands in existing tracking database.
management_features.gap: External sources must not be copied before quiescence, sanitization and two-key admission.

management_features.name: Knowledge and document linkage
management_features.use_case: Navigate between source architecture, wiki, decision records and detailed features.
management_features.shall: Knowledge pointers SHALL preserve locator, source revision, digest and relationship; rendered views SHALL remain projections.
management_features.negative: Detect an unresolved or stale knowledge reference without manufacturing runtime failure.
management_features.implementation: Current Hermes Wiki datastore/graph and Tailscale document serving.
management_features.gap: All rendered graph links require separate navigation validation.

management_features.name: Evidence retention at claim granularity
management_features.use_case: Ask which specific scenario passed at a particular candidate.
management_features.shall: Per-case assertions SHALL retain per-case evidence; aggregate logs SHALL remain labeled aggregate; absence SHALL remain unknown.
management_features.negative: Reject converting a suite count into fabricated per-case pass rows.
management_features.implementation: Hermes trace/receipt tables and ZigVM evidence-census retention semantics.
management_features.gap: The new manifest defines acceptance cases; it does not synthesize their execution receipts.

management_features.name: Strict product completion
management_features.use_case: Prevent partial or stale child evidence from admitting an entire product.
management_features.shall: Completion SHALL require every required child and matching candidate, reference, scenario, normalizer, runtime and formal receipt; empty sets SHALL NOT pass.
management_features.negative: A single missing child, stale candidate or mismatched trace pair must block strict completion.
management_features.implementation: Reuse the required-child fold behind a stronger evidence-binding collector.
management_features.gap: Existing low-level Boolean readers are insufficient alone.

management_features.name: Oracle inventory and provenance
management_features.use_case: Locate each behavioral reference and know what authority it can provide.
management_features.shall: Oracles SHALL distinguish specification, source, executable, recorded fixture and advisory model roles and preserve origin, owner and revision.
management_features.negative: A cloned repository alone must not be classified as an executed differential oracle.
management_features.implementation: Existing source registry and generated pin-observation artifact.
management_features.gap: Generic recursive inventory is not a sanitized UOS ingestion policy.

management_features.name: Oracle pin, license and executable identity
management_features.use_case: Reproduce a comparison against the intended reference build.
management_features.shall: An oracle execution SHALL bind full source revision, dirty-state receipt, license, build/toolchain, executable identity and observation time.
management_features.negative: Wrong major, modified source, mismatched license or unknown executable identity must withhold exact-pin credit.
management_features.implementation: Use UOS source authorities; adopt ZigVM source/runtime checks as separate observations.
management_features.gap: OTP-major equality plus Git HEAD is not exact executable provenance.

management_features.name: Oracle recipe discovery and coverage
management_features.use_case: Account for every fixture including ones not yet runnable.
management_features.shall: Each discovered vector SHALL have a typed bounded execution recipe or explicit nonpassing reason; no fixture may disappear from the denominator.
management_features.negative: Introduce an undiscovered recipe or compare two empty outputs; registry must report missing coverage or vacuity.
management_features.implementation: ZigVM vector discovery-totality and Hermes capability/scenario catalog patterns.
management_features.gap: Current service oracle registrations need executable differential adapters.

management_features.name: Bounded oracle execution
management_features.use_case: Run behavioral probes without letting the reference control the host.
management_features.shall: Execution SHALL enforce deadline, memory/output/process limits, sanitized environment and egress policy and reap the full process tree.
management_features.negative: Hanging, forking, noisy and network-denied fixtures must terminate within the declared budget and remain nonpassing.
management_features.implementation: Existing supervised bounded process boundary; use OTP for lifecycle control.
management_features.gap: Legacy Reference_capture only kills the direct child and does not establish these limits.

management_features.name: Normalization and fixture identity
management_features.use_case: Compare outputs fairly without erasing meaningful differences.
management_features.shall: Normalizer identity and rules SHALL be versioned with the fixture; load SHALL verify full scenario, snapshot and content identity.
management_features.negative: A forged scenario ID or altered normalizer must be rejected even when the trace's self-digest matches.
management_features.implementation: Existing Hermes versioned JSON normalizer with stronger surrounding identity checks.
management_features.gap: Reference_capture.load presently does not compare all requested identity fields.

management_features.name: Differential verdict and divergence handling
management_features.use_case: Explain exactly where native behavior differs from a reference.
management_features.shall: Comparison SHALL retain both normalized observations, comparator version and locality; unavailable or vacuous results SHALL never become equivalent.
management_features.negative: Known mismatches and empty outputs must be detected; a failed reference is blocked evidence rather than candidate success.
management_features.implementation: Current Hermes comparators, initial/final oracles and parity algebra.
management_features.gap: Service-level differential runs remain UNRUN in this review.

management_features.name: Regression, mutation and adversarial evidence
management_features.use_case: Prove a checker can detect the defects it claims to prevent.
management_features.shall: Regression and mutation records SHALL retain candidate, inputs, expected law, observed result and killed/surviving/unrun status.
management_features.negative: A deliberately corrupted candidate must fail the relevant acceptance; a survivor must remain a finding.
management_features.implementation: Existing Hermes negative-case and mutation mechanisms; focused catalog transaction tests.
management_features.gap: Full imported suites and production chaos were not executed.

management_features.name: Risk and dependency prioritization
management_features.use_case: Choose safe, ready work based on explicit impact and hazards.
management_features.shall: Selection SHALL apply safety class and readiness before C×T×F×Dep×I and record all four UCAs, raw FMEA and current evidence.
management_features.negative: An unready high-score task must not displace its prerequisite or grant execution authority.
management_features.implementation: Canonical UOS risk checker and Sa-plan selection evidence.
management_features.gap: Legacy wiki numeric priorities and onto_task repair records remain advisory.

management_features.name: Desired-state reconciliation
management_features.use_case: Compare a desired product state with observed evidence and expose drift.
management_features.shall: Reconciliation SHALL preserve explicit desired/actual states, unknown targets, dependency cycles and non-vacuous convergence.
management_features.negative: Reject unresolved dependencies and empty success; changed evidence must invalidate the affected observation.
management_features.implementation: Existing Blueprint validation, drift diagnostics and convergence logic.
management_features.gap: Never route a converged advisory model directly to deployment.

management_features.name: Operational analytics and cost evidence
management_features.use_case: Measure reliability and regressions without inflated sample counts.
management_features.shall: Reliability, cost and coverage summaries SHALL state population, retention, candidate and uncertainty; repeated samples SHALL NOT fabricate independent evidence.
management_features.negative: No sample or unknown provider cost must yield UNKNOWN or refusal rather than a favorable default.
management_features.implementation: Hermes receipt reliability, surprisal ledger and UOS quota accounting boundaries.
management_features.gap: Analytics are advisory and do not establish budget enforcement.

management_features.name: Release baseline and change control
management_features.use_case: Admit an exact product version and retain recovery evidence.
management_features.shall: A release baseline SHALL bind requirements, dependency snapshot, JJ candidate, approvals, runtime/formal receipts and rollback; no status label alone admits release.
management_features.negative: A changed candidate, revoked approval or stale evidence must withhold release authorization.
management_features.implementation: Existing run assurance, Sa-plan leases and UOS two-key admission rules.
management_features.gap: An integrated product release-baseline collector remains a gap.

management_features.name: Feedback and outcome learning
management_features.use_case: Connect observed user feedback to requirements and measured product benefit.
management_features.shall: Feedback SHALL retain its source, consent/scope, linked feature, hypothesis and measured outcome separately from proposed changes.
management_features.negative: Unmeasured outcomes must stay unknown and feedback must not silently rewrite a historical requirement.
management_features.implementation: Current journals/knowledge history plus explicit product metadata fields.
management_features.gap: A complete customer research and business-outcome workflow was not found in the inspected management models.
